name: bcdevexchange
headline: bcdevexchange site code
short_description: BC DevExchange is a web application supporting British Columbia's government in delivering better digital services through community collaboration.
author: bcgov

sections.overview:
BC DevExchange is a web application operated by the BC DevExchange Lab within the Government of British Columbia, designed to represent a supportive community enabling the government to deliver better digital services. Built with .Net Core 2.2 and deployed across multiple OpenShift environments, it uses Matomo for web analytics and SonarQube for code quality assurance. The platform integrates with the Eventbrite API for event data management and follows a structured deployment process across development, testing, and production environments. It solves the challenge of coordinating digital service initiatives across government by providing a centralized community hub.
Track website analytics and user engagement across BC government digital services
Manage and coordinate event data through Eventbrite API integration
Deploy and test code across multiple OpenShift environments
Ensure code quality and security using SonarQube analysis
